job.roleTitle: Vice President of Customer Experience Design and Strategy
job.rawJd:
Vice President of Customer Experience Design and Strategy

Position Summary
The Vice President of Customer Experience Design and Strategy (VP, Customer Experience Design and Strategy) is a senior executive responsible for defining and executing the organization's enterprise-wide customer experience (CX) vision by integrating customer strategy, experience design, service innovation, journey optimization, and digital transformation. This executive ensures that every customer interaction delivers a seamless, personalized, and consistent experience across all channels while driving customer satisfaction, loyalty, retention, and long-term business growth.

The Vice President partners closely with the Chief Customer Officer (CCO), Chief Experience Officer (CXO), Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), Chief Digital Officer (CDO), Chief Product Officer (CPO), Chief Operating Officer (COO), and executive leadership teams to embed customer-centric thinking into products, services, operations, and organizational strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Experience Strategy
Develop and execute a comprehensive enterprise-wide customer experience strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
Establish long-term CX roadmaps that improve customer satisfaction, loyalty, retention, advocacy, and lifetime value.
Define customer-centric operating models and governance frameworks.
Ensure customer experience initiatives support sustainable business growth and competitive differentiation.

Experience Design & Journey Optimization
Lead the design and optimization of end-to-end customer journeys across digital, physical, and hybrid channels.
Apply service design and human-centered design methodologies to improve customer interactions.
Identify customer pain points and redesign processes to create intuitive and frictionless experiences.
Standardize experience design principles across global business units.

Customer Insights & Voice of the Customer (VoC)
Lead enterprise Voice of the Customer (VoC) programs and customer research initiatives.
Utilize behavioral analytics, market research, customer feedback, and predictive insights to guide strategic decisions.
Develop executive dashboards tracking NPS, CSAT, CES, retention, churn, loyalty, and Customer Lifetime Value (CLV).
Translate customer insights into measurable operational improvements.

Digital Experience & Innovation
Partner with Product, UX/UI, Engineering, and Digital teams to enhance digital customer experiences.
Drive AI-powered personalization, omnichannel engagement, self-service capabilities, and automation initiatives.
Evaluate emerging technologies that improve customer interactions and operational efficiency.
Promote continuous innovation in customer engagement and experience management.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Customer Support, Product Management, Operations, IT, and Human Resources.
Ensure customer experience objectives are integrated into product development, service delivery, and operational processes.
Build a customer-first culture across all departments.
Align customer experience initiatives with revenue growth and operational excellence.

Governance & Performance Management
Establish enterprise CX governance, service standards, and operational policies.
Measure the effectiveness of CX initiatives through customer, operational, and financial KPIs.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives using Design Thinking, Lean, Six Sigma, and Agile methodologies.
Report customer experience performance and strategic progress to executive leadership and the Board of Directors.

Executive Leadership
Lead Customer Experience Directors, Service Design Directors, Customer Journey Managers, UX Leaders, Customer Insights teams, Experience Innovation Managers, and CX Program Managers.
Develop leadership capabilities and succession plans for customer experience organizations.
Manage CX budgets, technology investments, research programs, and strategic consulting partnerships.
Present customer experience strategy, performance metrics, and transformation initiatives to executive leadership and the Board of Directors.

Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Customer Experience, Human-Centered Design, Psychology, Communications, or a related field
MBA or Master's degree preferred
CCXP (Certified Customer Experience Professional), Design Thinking, Lean Six Sigma, Agile, Service Design, or Human-Centered Design certifications preferred
12–18+ years of progressive leadership experience in customer experience, customer strategy, service design, UX, digital transformation, marketing, or business operations
Proven experience leading enterprise-wide customer experience transformation initiatives
Strong expertise in customer journey mapping, service design, customer analytics, VoC programs, omnichannel strategy, and digital innovation
Excellent executive leadership, strategic planning, communication, and stakeholder management skills

Core Competencies
Customer Experience Strategy
Customer Experience Design
Customer Journey Management
Service Design
Human-Centered Design
Voice of the Customer (VoC)
Customer Analytics
Omnichannel Experience
Digital Transformation
Executive Leadership
